Yes,
Rehabmart
is a legitimate, well-established online retailer of medical equipment, therapy devices, and daily living aids
. Founded in 1998 by physical and occupational therapists and based in Watkinsville, Georgia, the company holds accreditation with the Better Business Bureau (BBB) and serves institutional, government, and retail buyers.

What to Keep in Mind
Shipping times:
Some items ship directly from third-party manufacturers, which can lead to longer lead times or "just-in-time" manufacturing delays.
Rehabmart.com
Return policies:
Because they sell medical and therapeutic gear, specific return rules and restocking fees often apply depending on the manufacturer.
Customer feedback:
While many buyers praise their wide selection and competitive pricing, others note that communication regarding backorders can occasionally be slow.
